title:
Instrument the §6 metrics dashboard for forge (umbrella .design/thermite2-program.md REQ-7 / AC-12: 'From M1, forge emits the routing-reason and verdict telemetry fields the §6 dashboard needs — cage-vs-forge share by reason, verdict counts, TV phase split — and the audit prints them'). ENVIRONMENT (use directly, do not probe external files): Verus at /Users/maxine/verus-dist/verus-arm64-macos/verus (export VERUS_BIN=/Users/maxine/verus-dist/verus-arm64-macos/verus + add dir to PATH); lake at /Users/maxine/.elan/bin; build the spine if needed: cd lean && lake build Thermite.Stabilize Thermite.Exec.Stmt Thermite.Exec.WhileBody.

Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit. STANDING SELF-VERIFY: python3 tooling/doc-drift.py (re-pin any design doc whose governed source you touch) + tooling/reqs check; finish 0-drift.

SCOPE: the §6 metrics DASHBOARD only (NOT the README headline flip, NOT cron CI). Two parts:
1. TELEMETRY: ensure forge surfaces the per-clause routing reason (cage/verus vs forge: nlsat vs lean, and WHY — relaxable / in-cage / lemma) and the per-clause verdict (the seven CertVerdict) — most of this is already in the schema-v2 per-clause engine/trust/verdict attribution + the TV phases; add any missing routing-reason field. Keep certs ADDITIVE: any new field is oracle-EXCLUDED (metrics are a projection, not part of the golden oracle) so v1 + forge-tier goldens stay byte-identical.
2. THE DASHBOARD (read-only projection): aggregate the telemetry into the §6 metrics and PRINT them via the audit surface — cage-vs-forge share BY ROUTING REASON, the seven-verdict counts, and the TV phase split (syntactic / semantic / timeout from the TV phases). CRITICAL: forge audit GATES NOTHING (#274, audit-manifest.md REQ-10) — the metrics are a READ-ONLY projection (a new section in forge audit, or forge audit --metrics, or forge review), they must NOT change any exit code or gate. Determinism: where a metric is deterministic, make it so; metrics output stays OUT of the certificate oracle_subset.

GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo test -p forge (VERUS_BIN + spine); clippy -p forge --all-targets -- -D warnings; fmt --check; doc-drift 0-drift; tooling/reqs check clean; v1 + forge-tier conformance goldens byte-identical (the metrics are oracle-excluded); audit exit codes UNCHANGED (a test pinning 'audit still gates nothing'). AC-12: a test asserts forge emits the routing-reason + verdict + TV-phase telemetry and the audit prints the dashboard. New verus/lake tests use verus_present()/lake_present() guards. No stubs/TODOs.

REGISTRY: register the §6-dashboard deliverable (REQ-7) in .design/reqs/registry.toml with typed evidence, or note under umbrella REQ-7.

SCOPE GUARDS: do NOT flip the README headline; forge audit MUST stay gating-nothing; no cage/combinator-menu change; never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json or .claude/settings.json. git push is blocked — commit locally, end with a clear summary, the orchestrator pushes. One branch.
